title: Soldier in Surreal Desert
description: A soldier in green camouflage uniform and cap stands bent-kneed on a winding desert road, looking directly at the viewer. The background features swirling orange sand dunes, a large red sun, purple cosmos flowers in the foreground, fragmented text reading 'NO' and 'JNO', and dramatic fiery brushstrokes.
prompt: A soldier in full green camouflage uniform and cap stands in the center of a winding desert road, knees bent and hands on thighs, staring intensely at the viewer. Dramatic swirling orange sand dunes rise behind him under a giant red sun. Purple cosmos flowers grow along the path. Chaotic fiery brushstrokes, floating diamond fragments and partial text elements reading NO and JNO appear in the composition, expressive surreal painting style.
